title:
EC ceiling $18K.
*Not for every EC*

lines.say: You heard the EC income ceiling went up to 18,000 dollars. It's not for every EC.
It only applies to sites sold from 24 August 2026.
Three upcoming ECs, at Senja Close, Woodlands Drive 17 and Sembawang Road, still use the old 16,000 dollar ceiling.
So a couple earning 17,000 dollars can't buy these, but may qualify for later ones.
Newer sites may also launch higher, as land prices rise.
Your income, the site and the timing all decide which EC is open to you.
Want to know which ECs you can buy? Comment ELIGIBLE.

caption:
Heard the EC income ceiling went up to $18,000? It's not for every EC. 🏠

The new ceiling only applies to sites sold from 24 August 2026. Three upcoming ECs, at Senja Close, Woodlands Drive 17 and Sembawang Road, still use the old $16,000 ceiling. So a couple earning $17,000 can't buy these, but may qualify for later ones. Newer sites may also launch higher as land prices rise.
